name: Yaka no Shitone
source:
Early Showa period. The epoch of castles is gone, but memory is alive. In one of such castles there is now a SM club. Only girls with the huge debts are sold there. Main heroine is one such girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
昭和初期。城堡的时代已经过去，但记忆仍然存在。其中一座城堡如今成了SM俱乐部，只有背负巨额债务的女孩会被卖到这里。女主角就是其中一人。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
